title: Medallion · Platform health
description: Is every component up, is data flowing end to end, what is firing?

options.content:
**MongoDB → Debezium → Kafka → bronze (Parquet) → PySpark → silver (Iceberg) → gold (StarRocks)**

A red tile means *that* component is down: follow **Component checklist** in `docs/how-to/operate-and-debug.md`.
The row *Data flow* reads left to right like the pipeline: the first red tile is usually the cause, the rest are symptoms.
Drill down with the dashboards menu (top right): *Pipeline*, *CDC & Kafka*, *Source*, *Storage & query*, *Gold Metrics*, *Kubernetes*.

panels.title: Components (up = the component answered its last metrics scrape; RustFS = pod ready)
MongoDB
panels.description: Source database (exporter sidecar). DOWN or NO DATA → `docs/how-to/operate-and-debug.md` › Component checklist › MongoDB.

panels.title: Kafka broker
panels.description: Strimzi KRaft broker/controller. DOWN or NO DATA → `docs/how-to/operate-and-debug.md` › Component checklist › Kafka broker.

panels.title: Kafka Exporter
panels.description: Topic offsets and consumer-group lag. DOWN or NO DATA → `docs/how-to/operate-and-debug.md` › Component checklist › Kafka Exporter.

panels.title: Kafka Connect
panels.description: Runs mongo-source (Debezium) and bronze-s3-sink (Aiven). DOWN or NO DATA → `docs/how-to/operate-and-debug.md` › Component checklist › Kafka Connect.

panels.title: RustFS (S3)
panels.description: Object storage for bronze/silver/gold and the LGTM stack. UP = pod ready (RustFS pushes metrics, so there is no scrape). DOWN or NO DATA → `docs/how-to/operate-and-debug.md` › Component checklist › RustFS (S3).

panels.title: Lakekeeper
panels.description: Iceberg REST catalog for silver. DOWN or NO DATA → `docs/how-to/operate-and-debug.md` › Component checklist › Lakekeeper.

panels.title: StarRocks FE
panels.description: Gold SQL frontend (MySQL :9030). DOWN or NO DATA → `docs/how-to/operate-and-debug.md` › Component checklist › StarRocks FE.

panels.title: StarRocks CN
panels.description: Gold compute node. DOWN or NO DATA → `docs/how-to/operate-and-debug.md` › Component checklist › StarRocks CN.

panels.title: Mimir
panels.description: Metrics store (and alert rules). DOWN or NO DATA → `docs/how-to/operate-and-debug.md` › Component checklist › Mimir.

panels.title: Loki
panels.description: Logs store. DOWN or NO DATA → `docs/how-to/operate-and-debug.md` › Component checklist › Loki.

panels.title: Tempo
panels.description: Traces store. DOWN or NO DATA → `docs/how-to/operate-and-debug.md` › Component checklist › Tempo.

panels.title: Alloy
panels.description: Collector: scrapes, logs, OTLP. DOWN or NO DATA → `docs/how-to/operate-and-debug.md` › Component checklist › Alloy.

panels.title: Users in MongoDB
panels.description: Live Users in the source collection, reported by the seeder every 30 s.

panels.title: mongo-source
panels.description: Debezium source connector state. Not RUNNING → guide › A connector is not running.

panels.title: CDC lag
panels.description: How far Debezium is behind MongoDB. Alert at 5 min → guide › CDC lag is high.

panels.title: bronze-s3-sink
panels.description: Aiven S3 sink state (Kafka → bronze Parquet).

panels.title: Last Pipeline run
panels.description: Outcome of the most recent run. FAILED → guide › A Pipeline run failed.

panels.title: Gold freshness
panels.description: Time since gold was last swapped in. Stale → run `make run-pipeline` or `make schedule-on`.

panels.title: Sink lag (messages)
panels.description: Change Events in Kafka not yet written to bronze. Flushes every 15 s, so small numbers are normal.

panels.title: Silver live Users
panels.description: Non-deleted Silver Users after the last run. Equals Users in MongoDB once the seeder is paused and the Pipeline ran.

panels.title: Data checks
panels.description: Share of data checks passing in the last run (1 = all).

panels.title: Pipeline Lag (max, last run)
panels.description: Oldest Change Event in the last run: its Event Position time until it reached silver.

panels.title: Since last success
panels.description: Time since the Pipeline last succeeded.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Alerts evaluated by the Mimir ruler (infra/k8s/alerts). Listed below.

panels.title: Firing / pending alerts
panels.description: Each alert's runbook annotation points at a section of the guide (Alerting › Alert rules shows it).

panels.title: Pods not ready / restarting
panels.description: A = pod not ready (value 1). B = restarts in the last hour. Completed Spark/Job pods are excluded by readiness. → guide › A pod keeps restarting.

panels.title: Memory working set by namespace
panels.description: Docker has 16 GB. If the total nears it, pods get OOM-killed (see Kubernetes dashboard).

panels.title: CPU by namespace
panels.description: CPU cores used per namespace.
